reasoning: The repo builds a long-running Go binary: an Envoy ext_proc gRPC server built on the llm-d Inference Payload Processor (IPP) framework, adapted from gateway-api-inference-extension's BBR. It attaches to an AI Gateway through an Istio EnvoyFilter and changes request and response headers and bodies using plugins in pkg/plugins: api-translation, apikey-injection, model-provider-resolver, external-metering, stream-usage-enforcer, maas-headers-guard, nemo and others. It ships as a Dockerfile and a Helm chart (deploy/payload-processing) installed into the Gateway's namespace. The same process also runs controller-runtime reconcilers for its own ExternalModel and ExternalProvider CRDs (api/inference/v1alpha1, config/crd). These create HTTPRoute, Service, ServiceEntry and DestinationRule resources, and there is a legacy migration controller. These controllers can be turned off with DISABLE_EXTERNAL_MODEL_CONTROLLER, and nothing manages operand lifecycle the way an operator does. So the main role is a data-plane request-processing service with controllers built in, not an operator.
